start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj plants ko herbs, shrubs aur trees mein group karenge. Aapko plants observe karna kaisa lagta hai?

turns.line: wo ped ke liye apni jaan de dete hain na?
turns.reply: Aapne kaha plants ped ke liye apni jaan de dete hain—isse ant mein zaroor jodenge. Ab school garden mein kaunsa plant chunenge, aur kyun?
